chunks: Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, from Musa ibn al-Husayn, from al-Sindi ibn Muhammad, from al-'Ala' ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:

I asked him about a man who is overcome by nosebleed or vomiting during the salat (prayer): what should he do? He said: He should turn away, wash his nose, and return to the salat (prayer). But if he speaks, then he must repeat the salat (prayer).

key_terms.يَعُودُ: he returns to continue the salat (prayer)
key_terms.يَنْفَتِلُ: he turns away or departs from his prayer position

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if nosebleed or vomiting occurs during salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one who experiences a nosebleed or vomiting during salat (prayer). He may leave briefly to wash and then return to his salat (prayer), but if he speaks during that interruption, he must repeat the salat (prayer).
